acceptance_criteria.description: Every strictly newer live same-epoch SESSION_READY performs an atomic presence-generation cutover before subsequent lifecycle traffic, clears old pending/reducer/renderer state, preserves required save semantics, emits ROM_READY, and has a focused regression.

Return-to-field and ownership-loss paths leave no active unsprited reserved ObjectEvent, never mutate reused identities, and deterministically recreate a visible remote without reducing real NPC capacity.
Remote animations progress instead of rewinding, while interpolation, continuous retargeting, exact six-frame arrival, zero sprite offsets, and discontinuity snap remain deterministic.

Only a fresh, effectively visible, proven owned renderer is interactable; stale, hidden, failed-spawn, and wrong-context remotes cannot consume A, and every overlapping real object or field action has precedence.

The outer-sequence regression matches production semantics and deterministic tests directly execute renderer lifecycle, interpolation, animation, staleness, warp, return-to-field, visibility, overlap, queue-full, hidden publication, and local-link isolation paths.

Focused Cloud Coop tests, modern ROM build, bridge-manifest unit and regeneration checks, and diff checks pass; root observation contains only the six discovery-approved files and the staged cumulative dependency tree remains exact.

closed_decisions: Treat staged cumulative candidate tree 0d9be6ee1fffb19cc1e5909d748a6bceb58d3e4b as immutable dependency context; leave the index untouched and produce only an unstaged correction in the six discovery-approved owned files.
Keep game protocol version 1, the 144-byte bridge frame, 128-byte payload, 32-slot queues, existing message IDs, the 9244-byte bridge layout, and the exact 28-byte LocalPresenceStateV1 unchanged.

A strictly newer same-epoch SESSION_READY is a transport-generation cutover even inside the live heartbeat window: clear old pending presence, reducer, renderer, and interaction eligibility before accepting replacement lifecycle traffic, preserve queued save semantics, and emit the documented ROM_READY without rewinding independent sequence domains.

Return-to-field sprite reset must not strand the reserved remote ObjectEvent or touch a reused identity. Retire or recreate only the proven remote object in SpawnObjectEventsOnReturnToField, then let the normal update restore it transactionally without evicting an NPC.
Start or seek remote sprite animation only when desired direction or animation changes. Preserve exact six-frame interpolation, continuous retargeting, zero x2/y2 offsets, and discontinuity snap.

An interaction is eligible only for a fresh, visible, currently re-resolved owned renderer in an allowed local on-foot overworld pose. Vanilla actionable real-object or field-script interaction has precedence; remote consumed-without-lock is the fallback only when the visible remote is the sole target, including queue-full send failure.
Remote ObjectEvents remain nonblocking and excluded from collision as source and target, while real overlapping objects remain discoverable and local-link or RFU behavior stays unchanged.

Repair the malformed-lifecycle outer-sequence regression to prove rejected traffic does not consume the sequence through a valid accepted lifecycle or the repaired documented same-epoch cutover; never encode a test-only behavior.

Use existing public presence runtime seams and focused engine globals to add deterministic tests for spawn/retry/ownership, palette and capacity failure, interpolation/retargeting/snap, animation progress, 90-frame staleness, stale/hidden/unowned interaction denial, warp and return-to-field teardown/recreation, real-object precedence, queue-full consumption, hidden publication, local-link isolation, and live same-epoch reconnect cutover.

Preserve exact checksum, length, epoch, type, and sequence fail-closed validation; never manufacture a local pose, serialize engine structs, leak MAP_OFFSET onto the wire, or equate source, warp, server, and outer bridge sequence domains.

forbidden_changes: Do not edit include headers, src/overworld.c, dist/bridge_manifest.json, src/coop/presence.c, test/coop/presence.c, Rust crates, Lua, build scripts, save layouts, maps, graphics assets, battle code, documentation, orchestration artifacts, or any file outside owned_files.

Do not bump a protocol or ABI version, change queue or bridge sizes, accept malformed or wrong-epoch lifecycle data, evict ObjectEvents, trust cached sprite ownership, allocate unbounded state, or weaken session-reset confinement.

Do not make remotes collide, mask a real overlapping object, consume an invisible or stale remote interaction, fall through after a genuine remote send, return a locking result without a script, or use sprite x2/y2 for interpolation.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, create or remove worktrees, or revert another worker's edits; preserve the sealed index and all unowned content.
objective: Repair the rejected cumulative ROM presence candidate so transport generation cutover, renderer recreation and animation, effective interaction visibility, real-object precedence, and deterministic runtime coverage satisfy the Phase 5 contract.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and every required command outcome is recorded.
A safe correction requires changing a frozen protocol, reducer, asset, save, or local-link boundary.
A concrete toolchain failure prevents further progress within the execution budget.
